mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{module}, #{action}, #{operationType}, #{operationResult}, NOW(), #{details}, #{ipAddress})
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_log SET user_id = #{userId}, module = #{module}, action = #{action}, operation_type = #{operationType}, operation_result = #{operationResult}, timestamp = #{timestamp}, details = #{details}, ip_address = #{ipAddress} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE module = #{module} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE action = #{action} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE operation_type = #{operationType} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE operation_result = #{operationResult} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE timestamp BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log WHERE ip_address = #{ipAddress} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, module, action, operation_type, operation_result, timestamp, details, ip_address FROM audit_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
